description: List the teams the signed-in user has joined (excludes archived teams).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Graph collection {"value": [...]} of team objects (id, displayName, description, visibility, isArchived, webUrl); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single team by its id.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the team object; on failure (team not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the channels belonging to a team.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Graph collection {"value": [...]} of channel objects (id, displayName, description, membershipType, webUrl, createdDateTime); on failure (team not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the messages in a channel, ordered newest first.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team that owns the channel.

channel_id.description: The unique id of the channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Graph collection {"value": [...]} of message objects; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Send a new message to a channel as the signed-in user.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team that owns the channel.

channel_id.description: The unique id of the channel to post to.

content_type.description: The content type of the message body (default 'html').

importance.description: The importance of the message, e.g. 'normal' or 'high' (default 'normal').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created message object; on failure (channel not found or missing content), output contains an error message.
